description: Turn on a FREE Link in Bio page served on the domain itself (up to 50 links; no scheduling, animation, passcode protection or analytics IDs). Nothing is charged. It starts with a placeholder title, bio and link: replace them with update_link_in_bio_profile, edit_link_in_bio_link and add_link_in_bio_link. The page needs Porkbun nameservers: if the domain uses others the call returns NAMESERVER_CHANGE_REQUIRED, so ask the user and resend with `agree_to_nameserver_change: true`. Replaces a free WordPress preview on the domain, never real hosting. Check get_link_in_bio first: many .com domains already have a free page. For 1000 links and every feature, a paid plan is bought with create_hosting (sku PIXIELINKSM1 $3/mo or PIXIELINKSY1 $30/yr), which upgrades a free page and keeps its content.

agree_to_nameserver_change.description: Allow switching the domain to Porkbun nameservers (needed when it uses others). Ask the user first.

domain.description: Domain whose Link in Bio page this is, e.g. `example.com`.

dry_run.description: Validate and preview without changing anything.
